Tiamonds Partners with Aconomy to Revolutionize Tokenized Asset Trading

#realworldassets #tokenization
February 25, 2025 - 2 min read

Tiamonds is excited to announce a strategic partnership with Aconomy, marking a significant step forward in the tokenized asset trading landscape. This collaboration enhances liquidity, broadens investor reach, and supports Tiamonds 2.0’s multi-asset, multichain expansion. 

“We are thrilled to partner with Aconomy, paving the way for an enhanced trading experience for tokenized diamonds and other real-world assets.”

— Steven Gaertner, Director of Tiamonds

“The future of RWA tokenization is built on trust, transparency, and decentralized ownership. At Aconomy, we are committed to bringing real-world assets on-chain with complete authenticity. By partnering with Tiamonds, we’re taking this vision forward—creating a decentralized economy where diamonds are verified, traded, and owned with absolute confidence. As a Validator, Tiamonds plays a key role in enhancing the credibility of tokenized diamonds and unlocking new liquidity opportunities in the dCommerce revolution.”

— Pushkar Vohra, Founder & CEO, Aconomy

Together, Tiamonds and Aconomy are set to revolutionize the real-world asset ecosystem through seamless, decentralized trading solutions. This collaboration brings the following benefits:

  • Access to Aconomy’s P2P Marketplace: Enabling seamless peer-to-peer trading and a decentralized exchange environment.
  • Increased Liquidity: Enhanced liquidity for tokenized assets. It ensures smoother trading experiences.
  • Wider Investor Reach: Tiamonds gains access to a broader investor base through decentralized trading avenues.
  • Multi-Asset, Multichain Expansion: This partnership supports Tiamonds 2.0’s vision for multi-asset and multichain growth. It also allows cross platform listings.
  • Strengthening the RWA Ecosystem: Promoting seamless asset exchange, further solidifying Tiamonds’ role in the RWA ecosystem.

Together, Tiamonds and Aconomy are set to redefine the landscape of tokenized asset trading.

About Tiamonds

Tiamonds is the world’s largest diamond marketplace, expanding its reach to include other real-world assets like gold, silver, sapphires, real estate, and financial instruments. Utilizing cutting-edge Web3 technology, Tiamonds empowers investors with freedom of ownership, offering a secure and transparent ecosystem. With a mission to redefine asset management, Tiamonds is paving the way for a more inclusive and accessible financial future.

About Aconomy

Aconomy is a decentralized asset economy platform designed to enhance liquidity for digital and real-world assets through its peer-to-peer marketplace. It empowers users to discover, trade, and manage tokenized assets with transparency and security. Aconomy aims to revolutionize asset trading with decentralized commerce and diversified investment opportunities.
